description: This source file defines the SaveLocationController class in the OrangeHRM system, handling the pre-render logic for location save/edit views, including setting up Vue components and permissions within the admin plugin.

classes.name: SaveLocationController
classes.description: Controller managing location save/edit logic in the admin plugin, rendering Vue components for location forms and handling permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component (either 'location-edit' or 'location-save') with necessary properties like location ID and list of countries, and sets permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability checks, specifically for location-related permissions.
